chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late twenties, the narrator's brother's wife, wearing a mustard-yellow house kaftan with white embroidery at the collar, a loose cream headscarf pushed back showing dark hair, gold bangles
chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man around 25, short black hair with a fade, light stubble, wearing a forest-green hoodie and black joggers, white socks

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the kitchen doorway, head-to-waist framing: in a modern Tangier apartment kitchen with white tiles, WIFE stands on tiptoe pointing up at a high wall cupboard with a sly smile, looking back over her shoulder at NARRATOR who stands just inside the door, puzzled. Warm evening light. 2D animated illustration, flat colours, expressive faces.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR reaches up to the high cupboard and hands WIFE a big jar; she takes it while standing very close to him, smiling, holding his gaze a bit too long; he looks awkward. Kitchen, medium shot, faces clearly visible. 2D animated illustration, flat colours.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR turns toward the kitchen door to leave for the living room, but WIFE leans on the counter blocking his way, chatting warmly with a hand on her chest; he stops, uneasy, half-turned. Medium shot, both faces visible. 2D animated illustration, flat colours.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: WIFE looks at NARRATOR with soft emotional eyes, touching her own cheek, saying something tender; NARRATOR stands frozen with wide eyes and a nervous swallow. Kitchen background blurred. 2D animated illustration, flat colours.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: WIFE, sad and complaining, gestures toward a wall clock showing past midnight, eyes rolling, while NARRATOR listens with raised eyebrows and a suspicious, confused face. Kitchen, medium shot, faces visible. 2D animated illustration, flat colours.
